prompt: Create one complete horizontal 16:9 medieval leaded STAINED-GLASS artwork, one coherent scene. The ENTIRE image must be made of translucent colored glass pieces separated by clearly visible dark lead cames: faces, hands, robes, objects, terrain and sky. Lead seams cross inside faces along forehead, brows, nose bridge, cheekbones and jaw; 10-16 facial panes, not smooth painted skin inside a stained-glass border. Believable natural anatomy and subtle expression, not cartoon, not photorealistic painting. Jewel-toned handmade glass, uneven texture, directional transmitted light with readable shadows. Environment and figures one continuous perspective, no comic panels or webpage cards. Keep key faces, hands and props within central 80% of image. No text, no lettering, no readable runes, no watermark, no logos, no crosses or unrelated religious imagery.  Theme subtitle for semantic guidance ONLY, do not draw words: 大地将会哭泣……. One tense conversation: Thrall and Cairne Bloodhoof disagree over Thrall's appointment of Garrosh. Thrall green orc, blue eyes, black braids, understated dark plate shoulders, defensive troubled face. Cairne elderly tauren with broad bovine muzzle, horns, brown fur and modest beads, disappointed but resolute. Waist-up two-person composition OUTDOORS at NIGHT in Orgrimmar beside a tall dead tree bearing an old massive demon skull trophy and fragments of demon armor, Cairne with folded arms, no other characters. No weapons drawn, no poison, no dead Cairne, no Deathwing prophecy in sky, no later shaman robe. Dim amber torchlight against deep blue night shadows. Theme how a leader can fail to hear a trusted warning.
